broker_resources.note: null broker is a validating loopback; user/system CPU and peak RSS via wait4 child rusage; disk writes are the broker artifacts only

rss.note: peak/average from a 10ms sampler over the measured phase only; baseline read at phase start (fixture + runtime); process_peak is ru_maxrss, monotonic per process

execution.latency_note: per-record delivery-latency bound: the enclosing fetch() call's duration, shared by every record in the batch; empty rounds carry no latency
